> ensure it's implemented in a non-removed manner in at least one engine.

Chromium does not remove features after parsing, and as far as I can tell from reading code on GitHub (which doesn't have as easy cross-referencing features), neither does WebKit.

Anyway, I think we should either update "check if a popup window is requested", or move the removal out of this sub-algorithm by just adding a step saying

> Remove _tokenizedFeatures_["`noopener`"] and _tokenizedFeatures_["`noreferrer`"].

at the top level of "window open steps", with no if statement surrounding them. (This works because [remove](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-remove) does nothing if the key is not present.)

I think either way would be worthwhile instead of having the algorithm modify its inputs. Sometimes algorithms need to modify their inputs, but here it's pretty unnecessary so I'd prefer if we avoided it.
